title: Suggestion
body: Great app, honestly. Helps with organizing and tracking habits, also motivates the users to challenge themselves to stick to their habits. I have a little suggestion. For the Apple Watch users, please add the streak length in days in the Apple Watch badge.
author: SalehBashatah

title: My favorite app ever
body: This app has a simple, elegant interface and has been a huge help in keeping me motivated to pursue my goals. There’s a certain game element I feel when I keep a streak going, kind of like hitting a combo. No clutter, keeps you on track, and I can see how far I’ve come in the calendar. I got the app on my mac too (I leave my phone off for hours of deep work). Thank you for a great app
author: Musinah

title: Awesome app for habit building
body: A must have app for any one who is interested in self improvement
author: Jose965
